Glitchy, buggy, inconsistent, and no guidance. Recently, this app I’ve been using awhile has become increasingly unusable and therefore irrelevant. I’m seeing similar reviews with how glitchy and buggy it has become. I thought the most recent update would help, but it did not. For me, it will no longer consistently register achievements, purchases, and accomplishments, and I see little ways to grow and strive/be provided with new resources and tools to help with my adhd.
There is little to no new interaction with my cub, and I’ve looked all over Reddit/the internet to find ways to increase any personality points even after following through with new goals, staying on top of routines, finishing daily goals/tasks/reflections/lessons, etc. This whole app just seems to be at a plateau that goes against it’s intended purpose of aiding adhd. Not at all happy and not at all planning to renew.

reviews.text:
ADHD vs Free Trial Challenge. Having ADHD, free trial periods can be less of a blessing and more of a curse. If I get distracted and miss days, I’m less likely to go back to something. It’s also harder for me to intentionally get into something new or create new routines. The “ADHD tax” (aka where your ADHD makes it way easier to forget to do things like cancel free trials and then end up paying money for something you don’t use later) is also a big problem. 

Because I have ADHD and didn’t get back to this app before my free trial was up, I never got to explore the app to see if this program -that’s supposed to be designed to help with problems I face with ADHD- would even be a good fit. There are no do-overs, no resets. If I wanted to explore the app now, I can’t do so without paying a large weekly fee or signing up for a larger fee/longer plan. I’m not saying it’s unfair or that having ADHD should get people special treatment. But an app designed to help with ADHD should maybe consider this is a problem for a large portion of their target audience.

Maybe the app is great for people like 
me, maybe it’s not. I’ll never know now.

reviews.text:
Just meh. I was expecting a lot more from this app. I'm more disappointed in it than I thought I would be at first. 

Pros: 
Cute panda

Easy to add goals

Easy to add sub-goals

Handy to open whenever I need to add something vs. needing to write it down in a planner

Cons:

If you don't complete a goal & don't have it set to repeat daily, it doesn't automatically stay on your list the next day. You have to re-add it every day or set it to repeat, & then delete it after you complete it. 

There is no interaction with the panda. It's cute, but it can't interact with you or any of the objects. It just sits there, so it's hard to actually care about it. I was hoping it would be more like taking care of a nano pet/tamagotchi. 

What you can spend bamboo on to buy things for the panda is extremely limited. How many beds, doors, windows, or chairs does one room need? It would be better if you could dress it clothes or give it snacks. 

It's a little buggy. I changed my panda's name, yet the notifications keep coming in with the old name. The challenge where you get treasure chests for finishing goals hasn't worked for me either. 

I wish you could easily change subgoals each day. I want to have a category & just change the subgoals, but if the goal repeats, the subgoals repeat too, & you have to manually delete old ones, not just mark them as complete. 

All in all, I don't think it's worth the cost. It's cute & I liked the idea of it at first, but the more you use it, the more limiting it becomes.
